pinned.title: Announce Stomper Customs: all the upholstery, and the interior goes black
pinned.meta: Talking head, alone in the truck, about 45 seconds. Afternoon slot, 4 to 7 pm.
script: Project truck guys, six companies just bet on a truck that can't move.
Number six is Stomper Customs. Upholstery and design.
Every stitch in that 1959 cab is theirs. The bench, the doors, the console, the wheel.
And it changed my mind on something. I had saddle brown leather picked out. Locked in.
It's going black. Tan truck, black everything else, and now black inside.
Here's what gets me. All I've got is an old cab and a plan. That's it.
And a guy who does this for a living looked at that and said, I'm in.
So if you've got a project sitting in the yard and you think nobody cares, somebody does.
Brown or black. Tell me I'm wrong.
shoot: Start talking as you sit down or shut the door, not after.
Hold up six fingers on the first line. That is the only prop.
Three takes straight through. Stop on "tell me I'm wrong" and cut there.
No thank-you list, no "go follow them". The tag in the caption does that.
pinned.caption:
Send this to the guy who would have picked brown.

Stomper Customs is doing every stitch in the 1959 cab, and the interior just went from saddle to black. @stompercustoms is partner number six on a truck that still can't leave the bay.

Brown or black, which one is right on a tan truck?
